name: Name
starting: Preparing the login on a platform device…
no-device: No platform device can log a subscription in right now. Try again later.
load-failed: The subscriptions could not be loaded: {reason}
status.not_readable: Logged in – the provider does not show its quota
remove.confirm: Remove this subscription and its readings?
revoke: Logged out. Also revoke the token at the provider:
use.label: Who may use it
title: Claude subscriptions
intro: Each subscription is logged in on a platform device and measured there; nothing runs on your computer. A new subscription is only measured until you choose who may use it.
automatic: Sign in through my mailbox (no code to paste)
email: Address to sign in with (empty: the mailbox's own)
own-mailbox: This subscription's own mailbox (for the automatic login)
own-mailbox.intro: The device reads this subscription's login e-mail there. The password is stored encrypted in the subscription and never shown again. Leave it empty to log in with link and code.
sign-in-email: Address to sign in with (empty: the mailbox's)
register: This address has no Claude account yet: create one
register.name: Full name of the account holder
register.birth: Date of birth (if the provider asks)
register.consents: Consents – tick only what the person whose address it is gave themselves
register.consent.terms: The account holder agreed to the provider's terms of use and privacy policy.
register.consent.age: The account holder confirmed having reached the provider's minimum age.
register.consent.marketing: The account holder wants to receive the provider's product e-mails.
orgs: Share with sessions of these organizations (empty: only measure)
batch.intro: Each subscription is logged in in its own sandbox, all at the same time. A subscription with its own mailbox logs itself in; for the others you open the link and paste the code.
batch.no-device: No platform device can log in several subscriptions at once right now. Please try again later.
mailbox.valid: The mailbox is reachable and the login works.
mailbox.invalid: The mail server refuses the login.
